notes.title: 🛠️ Known Issues & Enhancements for Nelli the Seer 🛠️
notes.content: [p][i]Brave Aztec warriors! While you travel through visions and forgotten ruins, we've spotted a few cursed bugs that slipped through the veil. Our development team is already on the warpath to cleanse these glitches from your path![/i][/p][h2][u][b]Known Issues (being actively worked on):[/b][/u][/h2][list][*][p][i]Achievements [b]"Dark Night"[/b], [b]"The End"[/b], [b]"Aztec Culture"[/b], and [b]"Athletic Flight"[/b] are currently not triggering correctly.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]A [b]rare crash[/b] may occur (we are investigating the exact cause).[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Rebinding controls[/b] is not applied properly and [b]resets between levels[/b].[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]VFX is missing during gliding[/b] in some cases.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]All of these issues are being addressed and will be fixed in an upcoming patch in september or sooner, which will also bring: [i]🎨 UI improvements 🎙️ Updated English voice-over[/i][/p][p]We appreciate your patience and your continued journey alongside Nelli.[/p][p]— [i]The Dev Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content: [h1]What changes have been made ?[/h1][p][/p][p]- FX fixed[/p][p]- Steam success fixed[/p][p]- Texture fixed[/p][p]- Bugs fixed (related to the save)[/p]
